anti_rules: Do not require video, aerial, or drone footage as the universal hero format.
Do not reuse the TOOTRIPSY wordmark, source file, time segment, crop dimensions, or encoding settings.
Do not upscale, soften, or substitute stock or template imagery for creator-owned work.

evidence.observed: Live loop cut from creator's own reel retained at native quality through crop, with creator name in front and matching full-resolution poster passed; still and soft-crop treatments were rejected as defects.

decisions.inferred_rule: Lead the hero with the creator's own strongest identity-bearing work at full native fidelity, with creator identity foregrounded and a matching fallback, allowing no visible quality compromise.
inputs_needed: Identification of creator's strongest identity-bearing owned asset
Native-quality source with rights to use it
Matching fallback poster at full resolution
decisions.name: Hero Asset Judgment
success_criteria: Lead media is recognizably the creator's own work, not stock or template
No visible softness, upscaling, or draft-quality compromise
Creator identity is legible in front of the media
Fallback poster matches hero framing at full resolution

anti_rules: Do not copy this build's section count, labels, or exact ordering as a template.
Do not transfer travel categories, postcard pillars, place groups, or named brands.
Do not replace creator story and proof with a gallery-only scroll or outbound link list.

evidence.observed: Post-hero scroll corrected to open with short first-person Story, then distinct brand proof and work proof, a full-bleed signature moment, media-kit proof, and inquiry close.

decisions.inferred_rule: Sequence the scroll creator-first: personal story, then distinct proof of demand and work including one signature moment, then commercial proof closing in direct inquiry.
inputs_needed: Verifiable proof of demand and selected work
Commercial proof and direct inquiry path
decisions.name: Sections Sequence Judgment
success_criteria: Creator story leads the post-hero scroll
Brand proof and work proof have distinct space
Scroll contains one full-bleed signature moment
Path resolves to commercial proof and direct inquiry, not a link list

anti_rules: Do not reuse the cool palette, accent color, typography, or motion vocabulary from this build.
Do not inherit the look of a reference build or generic portfolio template.
Do not transfer travel imagery, reel framing, or persona-specific restraint level.

evidence.observed: Direction deliberately departed from warm reference build to derive restrained, cinematic, image-led system from the creator's own grid and work so a follower recognizes the creator.

decisions.inferred_rule: Derive the visual system from the specific creator's observed record so the site reads as that creator, holding identity fidelity fixed while pushing craft ambition beyond templates.
inputs_needed: Observed record of creator's own content and persona
Reference builds or templates to explicitly diverge from
Image-led proof assets to ground the system
decisions.name: Visual Direction Judgment
success_criteria: System is recognizably derived from the creator, not a template
Look, density, and motion are coherent and restrained
No visible template or inherited reference-build identity

anti_rules: Do not copy this creator's phrases, motifs, vocabulary, or cadence.
Do not invent first-person quotations or unsourced facts.
Do not write about the creator in agency voice with stacked hype.

evidence.observed: Copy passed when written as short, plain, confident first-person grounded in creator's public words, avoiding agency-speak and hype.

decisions.inferred_rule: Write site copy as the creator in first person at a professional level, using short plain confident lines grounded in observed wording without agency description or invented statements.
inputs_needed: Creator bio, captions, and public wording
Agency copy drafts to strip of agency-speak
decisions.name: Voice Judgment
success_criteria: Story and labels speak in first person as the creator
Lines are short, plain, and confident without hype stacking
Wording is grounded in sourced creator language with no invented quotes

global_anti_rules: Do not transfer demonstration-specific nouns, imagery, palettes, type, phrases, brands, or layouts to another creator.
Do not treat demonstration assets, crops, encodings, counts, or orderings as universal requirements.
Do not bind this learning to any new creator or assume facts absent from that creator's record.
name: Creator Site Judgment
purpose: Encode transferable judgment for leading creator sites with identity fidelity, real proof, and ambitious craft.
